answer: Because the jade audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the sable bond on all of them and exposing each to the pearl slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 14 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 346 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
